caption: The drawing depicts a small, oval-shaped wooden table with a reddish-brown finish, standing on a single central pedestal base that splits into three curved legs. The main body of the table features doors or panels, with a visible knob or handle on the right side. Below the colored illustration of the table, there is a technical, pencil-drawn top and front view of the table’s structure, showing the tray section and interior layout. The background is plain and unadorned, off-white in color. There is a handwritten note in red ink on the lower right side reading “Note: Color accurate. Sent for sketch of interior inserted. A.C.”, and a name, “Edna Rex,” appears at the bottom.
title: Duncan Phyfe Sewing Cabinet
